constraint_id: milvus_type_int16_001 (DataType == Int16 for INT16 scalar fields)

contract_grounding.note: Contract defines scalar field types but REST v2 handler does not enforce strict type matching at the HTTP boundary.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 upsert request → handler_v2.go:upsert() → checkAndSetData() → field type switch → cast.ToBoolE/ToInt8E/ToInt16E (automatic string-to-type coercion)
source_grounding.note: Source接地发现:REST v2 handler使用spf13/cast库自动将字符串转换为目标类型(Bool/Int8/Int16等),未在HTTP边界进行严格类型检查。这导致API接受非法的字符串值而非拒绝。
